We need to determine appropriate crime(s) for this case.

Facts: Theft of 7 guihua (osmanthus?) trees from a company's orchard, value 5400 yuan. They dug up trees and stole them, then planted elsewhere waiting to sell. This is theft of property (trees). Under Chinese criminal law, theft of movable property? Trees are considered movable? Actually trees are considered 'plant' which is property, could be theft (盗窃) or maybe '抢夺' if by force? No force, secret. So theft (盗窃). Also the method: secret, premeditated, value > 1000 yuan qualifies as theft with relatively large amount. So charge: 盗窃罪.

Any other charges? Possibly '破坏森林植被' but not typical. The act of digging up trees could be considered '破坏森林植被' (damage to forest vegetation) under environmental law, but criminal law may have '破坏森林、草原、湿地等自然资源罪' (Article 338). However the case is about theft of property, not environmental. The prosecution says "以非法占有为目的，秘密窃取他人财物，数额较大" => theft. So answer: 盗窃.

Thus output: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
